operator confirms current IDE/product and workspace; not merely CLI --host flag
operator-observed global/team/project/nested instructions or UNKNOWN with explicit limitation
host-native skills/settings list visibly contains exact FDF skill name and workspace path
host-native invocation/activation visibly reports skill use, rather than guessed from local file presence
a read-only FDF proposal references actual project architecture and obeys original governing rules
Git status and/or file hashes before and after no-write exercise; unintended edits investigated
needed only if separately authorized test installation changed managed paths
separately recorded operator decision; not an assistant-generated approval assertion
